c74object.name: mc.syncSuite.decorrelator~
c74object.digest: Decorrelates the channels of a layout (or spreads one input over N) without colouring them.
c74object.description: Each channel runs its own cascade of six Schroeder allpass sections (random prime delays up to length, gains +-0.55 with random signs, from seed and the channel number). An allpass has an exactly flat magnitude response: nothing is coloured, the channels only differ in phase, so their mutual correlation falls (|r| < 0.1 between 16 channels of white noise at the default 10 ms; energy kept exactly). Uses: a mono source spread over many speakers without comb filtering and without collapsing into a phantom image (one input + @channels N), a correlated stem made diffuse, an upmix. TRANSIENTS: a fast / slow envelope detector briefly returns each channel to the dry signal on attacks (transient = sensitivity), so they stay sharp and in the same place on every speaker. AMOUNT blends dry and decorrelated at constant energy. Parameter changes run the old and the new cascades side by side and crossfade over 50 ms. No latency. Display: correlation matrix before and after (cyan negative, pink positive), mean |r| of all pairs, and every channel's impulse response. CPU: about 0.02 % of a core per channel.

method.name: signal
method.description: A multichannel signal, one channel per speaker (up to 128).

method.name: get
method.description: mean_abs <input> <output> (mean |r| over all pairs), matrix <C x C output correlation>.

attribute.name: speaker_coords
attribute.description: One azimuth per channel (channel i = speaker i), the same message syncSuite.nodes uses and outputs (get_speakers). Empty = an even ring of the non-LFE channels straddling the front (2 = L/R, 4 = quad, 8 = octagon).

attribute.name: speaker_elevations
attribute.description: Degrees, up, one per channel (missing = 0). All spatial computations are in 3D; the displays are top views.

attribute.name: lfe
attribute.description: Channels that are LFE: they have no position and are kept out of the spatial processing and the loudness. lfe with no values = none.

attribute.name: amount
attribute.description: 0 = dry (bit for bit), 1 = fully decorrelated; in between, constant energy.

attribute.name: length
attribute.digest: Longest allpass delay (ms): more = less correlation, more smear
attribute.description: Longest allpass delay (ms, 1..50): longer = lower correlation, more time smearing. Default 10.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Longest allpass delay (ms): more = less correlation, more smear

attribute.name: transient
attribute.description: Keep attacks dry (0 = off, 1 = most sensitive). Default: 0.5.

attribute.name: seed
attribute.description: Random seed of the cascades: the same seed always gives the same filters. Default: 1.

attribute.name: channels
attribute.digest: Output channels (0 = as many as the input)
attribute.description: Output channels: 0 = as many as the input. With one input channel and channels N, the input is spread over N decorrelated outputs.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Output channels (0 = as many as the input)

attribute.name: view
attribute.description: Which panels are drawn: all, or one of them filling the box. Values: 0 = all, 1 = matrix, 2 = impulses (a number or the name). Default: 0.

attribute.name: bypass_ui
attribute.description: 1: nothing is drawn and the display timer stops; the audio and the message output are not affected (use it when the box is hidden or while performing). Default: 0.

attribute.name: output
attribute.description: 1: the measurements (see get) are output at every display refresh with new data. 0: only on get.

attribute.name: interval
attribute.description: Display refresh and output rate. The processing does not depend on it. Default: 33.

attribute.name: no_ui
attribute.digest: No UI: a plain object box
attribute.description: Type it with the object (mc.syncSuite.limiter~ @no_ui 1): the box looks and sizes like a standard object box, draws nothing, runs no display timer and skips the display-only metering. Max decides per class whether a box is a UI box, so the box stays resizable, but it behaves as a standard object: audio, messages and get work as usual. Default: 0.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: No UI: a plain object box

attribute.name: window
attribute.description: Correlation display window (ms). Default: 300.

attribute.name: bgcolor
attribute.description: Box background (syncSuite style: near black).

attribute.name: panelcolor
attribute.description: Panel background.

attribute.name: textcolor
attribute.description: Labels and numbers.

attribute.name: gridcolor
attribute.description: Scales and guides.

attribute.name: color
attribute.description: Main signal colour (syncSuite hot pink).

attribute.name: alarmcolor
attribute.description: Overs, clips, gated / frozen states (acid yellow).

inlet.digest: Speaker feeds (channel i = speaker i) and messages

outlet.digest: Decorrelated channels (as many as the input, or @channels)
Measurements: mean_abs <in out>, matrix <output correlation, C x C>
